SELECT f.* FROM `ent-knowledge-intel-pipeline`.`silver_v4`.`component_findings` f
LEFT JOIN `ent-knowledge-intel-pipeline`.`silver_v4`.`component_queries` q
ON q.source_sha256=f.source_sha256 AND q.bom_ref=f.bom_ref
AND q.osv_query_sha256=f.osv_query_sha256 AND q.status='SUCCESS'
WHERE q.bom_ref IS NULL

select source_sha256
from `ent-knowledge-intel-pipeline`.`silver_v4`.`sboms`
where source_sha256 is null

with dbt_test__target as (

  select source_sha256 as unique_field
  from `ent-knowledge-intel-pipeline`.`silver_v4`.`sboms`
  where source_sha256 is not null

)

select
    unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from dbt_test__target
group by unique_field
having count(*) > 1

-- Latest inventory per application AND release; retain all historical releases.
WITH ranked AS (
 SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
   PARTITION BY sbom_id, COALESCE(release_tag, 'fixture')
   ORDER BY COALESCE(generated_at, retrieved_at) DESC, source_sha256 DESC
 ) AS rn
 FROM `ent-knowledge-intel-pipeline`.`silver_v4`.`sboms`
)
SELECT sbom_id AS application_id, source_sha256 AS sbom_sha256,
       root_component_ref, retrieved_at AS inventory_first_seen,
       COALESCE(release_tag,'fixture') AS release_tag,
       repository_url, git_commit, commit_at, generated_at
FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1

-- Breadth-first shortest paths computed in Python; no recursive path explosion.
SELECT p.sbom_sha256, p.bom_ref, p.path_text, p.hops
FROM `ent-knowledge-intel-pipeline`.`gold_v4`.`component_paths` p
JOIN `ent-knowledge-intel-pipeline`.`gold_v4`.`int_current_sboms` s ON s.sbom_sha256=p.sbom_sha256

-- OSV's exact-version matching is evidence of a known match, not exploitability.
WITH latest_vulns AS (
 SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY osv_id ORDER BY modified_at DESC,retrieved_at DESC,source_sha256 DESC) AS rn
 FROM `ent-knowledge-intel-pipeline`.`silver_v4`.`vulnerabilities`
)
SELECT s.application_id,root.name AS application_name,
       s.release_tag,s.git_commit,s.commit_at,
       c.bom_ref,c.name AS component_name,
       q.package_name,c.version AS component_version,
       f.vulnerability_id,'KNOWN_VULNERABILITY' AS finding_status,
       'UNRATED' AS severity_label,
       'https://osv.dev/vulnerability/' || f.vulnerability_id AS advisory_url,
       s.sbom_sha256,q.osv_query_sha256,
       CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS sbom_gcs_uri,
       s.inventory_first_seen,
       CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) AS v2_cvss_score,
       v.published_at AS v2_published_at,
       p.path_text AS v2_dependency_path,
       v.summary AS v2_vulnerability_summary,
       q.queried_at AS evaluated_at,
       CASE WHEN v.osv_id IS NULL THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'AVAILABLE' END AS advisory_enrichment,
       CASE WHEN p.bom_ref IS NULL THEN 'PATH_UNKNOWN' ELSE 'PATH_AVAILABLE' END AS dependency_path_status,
       v.source_sha256 AS advisory_sha256, v.modified_at AS advisory_modified_at,
       v.retrieved_at AS advisory_retrieved_at
FROM `ent-knowledge-intel-pipeline`.`gold_v4`.`int_current_sboms` s
JOIN `ent-knowledge-intel-pipeline`.`silver_v4`.`sbom_components` root
 ON root.source_sha256=s.sbom_sha256 AND root.bom_ref=s.root_component_ref
JOIN `ent-knowledge-intel-pipeline`.`silver_v4`.`sbom_components` c
 ON c.source_sha256=s.sbom_sha256 AND NOT c.is_root
JOIN `ent-knowledge-intel-pipeline`.`silver_v4`.`component_queries` q
 ON q.source_sha256=c.source_sha256 AND q.bom_ref=c.bom_ref AND q.status='SUCCESS'
 AND q.component_version=c.version
JOIN `ent-knowledge-intel-pipeline`.`silver_v4`.`component_findings` f
 ON f.source_sha256=q.source_sha256 AND f.bom_ref=q.bom_ref AND f.osv_query_sha256=q.osv_query_sha256
LEFT JOIN latest_vulns v ON v.osv_id=f.vulnerability_id AND v.rn=1
LEFT JOIN `ent-knowledge-intel-pipeline`.`gold_v4`.`int_component_paths` p
 ON p.sbom_sha256=c.source_sha256 AND p.bom_ref=c.bom_ref

SELECT sbom_sha256,bom_ref,vulnerability_id,COUNT(*) AS n
FROM `ent-knowledge-intel-pipeline`.`gold_v4`.`mart_application_findings`
GROUP BY sbom_sha256,bom_ref,vulnerability_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1

select vulnerability_id
from `ent-knowledge-intel-pipeline`.`gold_v4`.`mart_application_findings`
where vulnerability_id is null

SELECT 'app:' || s.sbom_sha256 AS source_id, 'HAS_INVENTORY' AS relation,
       'component:' || s.sbom_sha256 || ':' || s.root_component_ref AS target_id,
       s.sbom_sha256 AS sbom_sha256, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS osv_query_sha256
FROM `ent-knowledge-intel-pipeline`.`gold_v4`.`int_current_sboms` s
UNION DISTINCT
SELECT 'component:' || d.source_sha256 || ':' || d.parent_bom_ref,
       'DEPENDS_ON', 'component:' || d.source_sha256 || ':' || d.child_bom_ref,
       d.source_sha256, CAST(NULL AS STRING)
FROM `ent-knowledge-intel-pipeline`.`silver_v4`.`sbom_dependencies` d
JOIN `ent-knowledge-intel-pipeline`.`gold_v4`.`int_current_sboms` s ON s.sbom_sha256=d.source_sha256
UNION DISTINCT
SELECT 'component:' || f.sbom_sha256 || ':' || f.bom_ref,
       'AFFECTED_BY','vuln:' || f.vulnerability_id,
       f.sbom_sha256, f.osv_query_sha256
FROM `ent-knowledge-intel-pipeline`.`gold_v4`.`mart_application_findings` f

-- Keep release-inventory node IDs separate; vulnerability IDs may be shared.
SELECT 'app:' || s.sbom_sha256 AS node_id, 'Application' AS node_type,
       root.name || ' [' || s.release_tag || ']' AS label, s.sbom_sha256 AS source_sha256
FROM `ent-knowledge-intel-pipeline`.`gold_v4`.`int_current_sboms` s
JOIN `ent-knowledge-intel-pipeline`.`silver_v4`.`sbom_components` root
 ON root.source_sha256=s.sbom_sha256 AND root.bom_ref=s.root_component_ref
UNION DISTINCT
SELECT 'component:' || c.source_sha256 || ':' || c.bom_ref,
       'ComponentVersion', c.name || '@' || COALESCE(c.version,'unknown'), c.source_sha256
FROM `ent-knowledge-intel-pipeline`.`silver_v4`.`sbom_components` c
JOIN `ent-knowledge-intel-pipeline`.`gold_v4`.`int_current_sboms` s ON s.sbom_sha256=c.source_sha256
WHERE c.bom_ref IS NOT NULL
UNION DISTINCT
SELECT 'vuln:' || f.vulnerability_id, 'Vulnerability', f.vulnerability_id, CAST(NULL AS STRING)
FROM `ent-knowledge-intel-pipeline`.`gold_v4`.`mart_application_findings` f

-- Counts are per release inventory, never pooled across different versions.
WITH aggregated AS (
 SELECT sbom_sha256, COUNT(*) AS finding_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT bom_ref) AS affected_components
 FROM `ent-knowledge-intel-pipeline`.`gold_v4`.`mart_application_findings` GROUP BY sbom_sha256
), path_coverage AS (
 SELECT c.source_sha256 AS sbom_sha256, COUNT(p.bom_ref) AS components_with_path
 FROM `ent-knowledge-intel-pipeline`.`silver_v4`.`sbom_components` c
 LEFT JOIN `ent-knowledge-intel-pipeline`.`gold_v4`.`int_component_paths` p ON p.sbom_sha256=c.source_sha256 AND p.bom_ref=c.bom_ref
 WHERE NOT c.is_root
 GROUP BY c.source_sha256
), coverage AS (
 SELECT s.sbom_sha256,
        COUNT(c.bom_ref) AS components_to_query,
        SUM(CASE WHEN q.status='SUCCESS' AND q.component_version=c.version THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS components_queried,
        SUM(CASE WHEN q.status='FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_queries,
        SUM(CASE WHEN q.status='SKIPPED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS skipped_queries,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.bom_ref IS NOT NULL AND q.bom_ref IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_queries,
        MIN(q.queried_at) AS first_evaluated_at, MAX(q.queried_at) AS last_evaluated_at
 FROM `ent-knowledge-intel-pipeline`.`gold_v4`.`int_current_sboms` s
 LEFT JOIN `ent-knowledge-intel-pipeline`.`silver_v4`.`sbom_components` c
  ON c.source_sha256=s.sbom_sha256 AND NOT c.is_root
 LEFT JOIN `ent-knowledge-intel-pipeline`.`silver_v4`.`component_queries` q
  ON q.source_sha256=c.source_sha256 AND q.bom_ref=c.bom_ref
 GROUP BY s.sbom_sha256
)
SELECT s.application_id, root.name AS application_name, s.release_tag,
       s.git_commit,s.commit_at,s.repository_url,s.generated_at,
       COALESCE(a.finding_count,0) AS finding_count,
       COALESCE(a.affected_components,0) AS affected_components,
       CASE WHEN co.components_to_query=0 OR co.components_queried < co.components_to_query THEN 'QUERY_INCOMPLETE'
            WHEN COALESCE(a.finding_count,0)>0 THEN 'KNOWN_VULNERABILITY'
            ELSE 'NO_MATCH_IN_QUERIED_OSV' END AS risk_flag,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.finding_count,0)>0 THEN 'UNRATED' WHEN co.components_to_query=0 OR co.components_queried < co.components_to_query THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE 'N/A' END AS severity_label,
       s.sbom_sha256 AS inventory_snapshot_sha256,
       co.components_to_query, co.components_queried,co.failed_queries,co.skipped_queries,co.missing_queries,
       co.first_evaluated_at,co.last_evaluated_at,
       COALESCE(pc.components_with_path,0) AS components_with_dependency_path,
       co.components_to_query-COALESCE(pc.components_with_path,0) AS components_without_dependency_path
FROM `ent-knowledge-intel-pipeline`.`gold_v4`.`int_current_sboms` s
JOIN `ent-knowledge-intel-pipeline`.`silver_v4`.`sbom_components` root
 ON root.source_sha256=s.sbom_sha256 AND root.bom_ref=s.root_component_ref
LEFT JOIN aggregated a ON a.sbom_sha256=s.sbom_sha256
LEFT JOIN coverage co ON co.sbom_sha256=s.sbom_sha256

LEFT JOIN path_coverage pc ON pc.sbom_sha256=s.sbom_sha256

       (components_to_query=0 OR components_queried <> components_to_query OR finding_count <> 0))
